claim: Density-error selection can distort a protected rate
quantity_or_estimand: paired filtered/CIC rate and density-error objective
uncertainty: paired 95% seed bootstrap; duration and floor gates
permitted_wording: The density-selected width produced a large measured rate distortion; its complete validation also fails duration/floor criteria.

claim: A constant filter transfer produces drift-dependent relative rate shifts
quantity_or_estimand: registered slope of log mean amplitude; constant W2=0.99095494
permitted_wording: With initial density and fixed transfer held constant, measured rate preservation varies with beam drift over the resolved projected scan.

claim: The R=0.95 constrained Gaussian settings preserve the selected rate
uncertainty: paired 95% intervals wholly in [0.90,1.10]; signal and duration pass
permitted_wording: The precomputed interior settings preserve the measured projected-mode rate over the four signal-resolved drift points.

claim: The v_b=0.818 extension validates near-marginal preservation
uncertainty: frozen SNR and delta-f gates fail
permitted_wording: The extension completed, but no accepted near-marginal rate or preservation result is available.

claim: The actual R=0.95 E2 width retains a noise benefit
quantity_or_estimand: density and pre-gather grid-field squared-error power ratios
scope: full-f E2 v_b=0.80; PPC32 vs paired PPC1024; t=[0.5,4]
data: deterministic replay of seeds 100--109 anchored to saved q050/boundary metrics
permitted_wording: At sigma_y=0.173859 dy the short full-f replay reduces density-error power 1.0813x and pre-gather grid-field-error power 1.0386x; this is not particle-force noise or a same-history rate result.

claim: Weak-Landau C4 provides a same-campaign noise-rate trade-off
quantity_or_estimand: coherent complex-field envelope rate plus density/grid-field error power
scope: 40 fresh paired PPC1024 seeds; global velocity loading
permitted_wording: C4/CIC is 0.9894 [0.9679,1.0138] with 3.259x density and 1.613x grid-field error-power reductions, but the paired CIC baseline spans only 1.721 e-foldings.

claim: Compensated p=2,n=2 and p=3,n=4 preserve the E2 corner rate
verdict: ESTABLISHED FOR RATE; PRACTICAL TRADE-OFF CONDITIONAL
permitted_wording: Both settings pass measured rate, signal and duration gates; quoted noise benefits come from a separate campaign.

claim: The exact compensated dispersion model is statistically calibrated
permitted_wording: The predictions preserve the broad ordering but all four lie outside the reported measured intervals; preservation and calibration are distinct.

claim: Matched filters enter once at deposition and once at gather
permitted_wording: The saved grid field has one W factor and the gathered particle force has W2 relative to CIC.

claim: Raw n-pass binomial is globally equivalent to sigma=sqrt(n/2) Gaussian
permitted_wording: The Gaussian width is a low-k correspondence only; exact binomial transfers are used quantitatively.

claim: Current seed-rate spread is primarily a fit-window artefact
quantity_or_estimand: individual rates across fixed sensitivity windows
permitted_wording: Window shifts are small compared with seed SD; seed-specific finite-marker loading explains the spread.

claim: C4 is universally or globally optimal
permitted_wording: C4 is a protected-mode operating rule evaluated on specified families and modes; no universal/global optimality claim is permitted.

claim: The method has unrestricted nonlinear full-f fidelity
quantity_or_estimand: nonlinear phase space, harmonics, saturation and particle force
verdict: MISSING AND NOT REQUIRED FOR NARROWED CLAIM
permitted_wording: The current evidence supports projected linear dynamics plus separately scoped full-f grid-error measurements, not unrestricted nonlinear fidelity.
